props.heading: Meals of Hope 2026
props.lede: Saturday, November 14th at 4:00 pm. Two hours, thousands of meals, and everyone who showed up.

props.heading: Pack meals for children in Haiti
props.body:
This is a tangible way to feed children in Haiti who may not otherwise eat that day. Help us pack as many meals as we can. You can join in by sponsoring meals alongside other local businesses, by bringing a team to pack, or both.

Got a team you want to bring? Sign up below and we'll save you a table.

facts.label: Who can come
facts.value: Kids as young as 5 through adults — every age has a job

facts.label: Where the meals go
facts.value: Children in Haiti, through Mission of Hope

props.title: Why this matters
props.body:
There is a massive food crisis in Haiti. Children who often eat just one meal a day are beginning to miss that single important meal.

Malnourishment and hunger don't belong in this world, and together we have the resources to change it. For just $0.35 a meal, you can fill a belly tomorrow.

props.title: Two hours, thousands of meals.
props.body:
A meal-packing event is something to be part of. We spend about two hours packing thousands upon thousands of meals. We need kids as young as five to scoop the rice, teens to seal the bags, and adults to weigh out the portions.

This is a chance to use your hands and feet to serve the poorest of the poor. Bring your business and your clients, your teammates and your coworkers, your family and your friends.
